message.content:
A standard deck has 26 red cards and 26 black cards.

Total ways to choose 3 cards:

\[
\binom{52}{3}=22100
\]

Ways to choose 3 red cards:

\[
\binom{26}{3}=2600
\]

Ways to choose 3 black cards:

\[
\binom{26}{3}=2600
\]

So the number of ways to choose 3 cards that are all the same color is:

\[
2600+2600=5200
\]

Therefore, the number of ways to choose 3 cards that are not all the same color is:

\[
22100-5200=16900
\]

Thus the probability is:

\[
\frac{16900}{22100}=\frac{13}{17}
\]

The answer is \(\frac{13}{17}\).
